extraction.notes: Reconciliation starts from net loss attributable to common stockholders (not the cash-flow net loss of $(7,844)). Per-share figures use the basic weighted average of Common Stock and Class A Units (56,723K), which reproduces $0.05 FFO, $0.19 Core FFO and $0.15 AFFO; the diluted count of 62,457K does not reproduce Core FFO per share. Gain on sale of real estate is nil in 2022. Categorization judgment calls: Internalization costs coded as 'other'; deemed dividends/preferred call expenses coded as 'other'; CECL non-cash income, net loan origination fees, lease inducement amortization, non-cash loan interest income and deferred revenue amortization coded as 'other'. Straight-line/intangible liability amortization coded straight_line_rent. Recurring capex is subtracted in AFFO, so recurring_capex_disclosed is null. Arithmetic checks: FFO 2,846; Core 10,827; AFFO 8,711.
